title: How is Grug connected to Napoleon?
description:
Grug from The Croods connects to Napoleon through Nicolas Cage, Elvis, two presidents and France's line of rulers.

Grug → Nicolas Cage → Lisa Marie Presley → Elvis Presley → Richard Nixon → Charles de Gaulle → Napoleon

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
